# Demo data (synthetic)

**Everything here is FAKE.** The files describe an invented person, generated by `scripts/make-demo-data.mjs`
from seeded random generators. They are nobody's health data, and every row carries a `Demo …` source tag
(`Demo Watch`, `Demo Scale`, `Demo Strava`, …).

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `extract/*.csv` | The Apple Health extract of the invented person |
| `extract/workout-zones.csv` | Per-workout heart-rate zones, derived from the `Demo Strava` rows of `workouts.csv` (each session starts at 18:00 local, so it has a window) |
| `extract/hr-hourly.csv` | Watch heart rate per clock hour for the last four weeks, leaving the workout windows out like the Shortcut sync; with the zones it calibrates the day strain dial (daytime heart rate 58–70 bpm, so stress and the energy bank show ordinary days) |
| `extract/journal-daily.csv` | An invented behaviour journal (drinks mostly at weekends, mobility on rest days…) for My journal and its insights; any association with the demo recovery is chance |
| `extract/foodlog-daily.csv` | An invented food log in the sync's format (`data/nutrition/sync-foodlog.mjs`) around the example plan's maintain targets, a few days missing a dinner or a macro, for the nutrition score |
| `strava-profile.json` | A hand-written Strava athlete snapshot (name, gear, devices) for the example's profile sheet, in place of the gitignored `data/profile/strava-profile.json` |

## Why it exists

`npm run build:example` (`DATA_MODE=example`) reads this folder in place of your real,
gitignored `data/apple-health/extract/`. That way the example page shows every section
(the Home dials, Health, Training, the intake rings) on a fresh clone, before you drop your own
export.

## Regenerate

```bash
node scripts/make-demo-data.mjs                     # fixed defaults: identical bytes every run
node scripts/make-demo-data.mjs --end 2026-12-31    # move the window (the files change)
```

The window ends on a fixed date, so the example page reads as stale (dimmed dials, no intake
rings) a few days after that date. That is the page's normal staleness handling, not a bug.
The test `scripts/make-demo-data.test.mjs` fails if these files drift from the generator.

## Rules

- Never put real measurements here: this folder is tracked and public.
- Your own data goes in `data/apple-health/` (gitignored), never in `data/demo/`.
